verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a web editor as an alternative to Git for content changes. From that editor, users can preview changes, share them with the team, and approve and merge pull requests, so web edits flow into the same repository as Git-based edits. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the editor is a visual/WYSIWYG experience suited to non-technical users, detail on how editor commits sync with the Git repo, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a technical writer, non-technical teammates can edit docs in a visual web editor without touching git, and their changes flow into the same source of truth
